question: Two light waves of equal amplitude reach a point with a phase difference of $0$. What will be the resultant intensity compared to the intensity due to one wave?

options.A: $I$, equal to the intensity due to one wave.
options.B: $2I$, twice the intensity due to one wave.
options.C: $4I$, four times the intensity due to one wave.
options.D: $0$, because the waves cancel each other.
